summary_ja: 平成25年12月31日まで、証券化エクスポージャーの個別リスクの額を新告示第280条の9を準用して算出できる。
summary_en: Until December 31, 2013, allows specific risk for securitization exposures (other than correlation trading) to be calculated by applying Article 280-9 of the New Public Notice mutatis mutandis.
paragraphs: Until December 31, 2013, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company may use, as the amount of specific risk of securitization exposures (excluding those relating to correlation trading), the amount calculated by applying Article 280-9 of the New Public Notice mutatis mutandis.
